note: Both sets correctly capture the 4 m off-axis monolith baseline, the perfect starlight rejection conditions, the locally zeroed field amplitude, and the charge–aberration-sensitivity trade, and both redundantly repeat the starlight-rejection and topological-charge-definition claims. Set B additionally extracts two well-supported facts A misses (VVC is a phase-based coronagraph; the imprinted phase screw dislocation e^{ilθ} at the instrument focus), while A adds a vague, misbound 'inverse' relationship claim and binds the definition of l to the VVC as if it were a measured value. Both sets contain one misbound topological-charge claim and one condition-dropping duplicate, but B has fewer defective claims and more correct coverage.
